_comment: The native shell's brand table (DR-0570). One local Android app per family brand, built by .github/workflows/native-shell.yml from the SAME Vite app the web serves, at base '/'. appId is deliberately NOT the TWA lane's package id (us.poetech.app etc.): both lanes are kept, so both apps must be installable on one phone side by side while the local app soaks. `start` is the first page the shell opens — a brand's OWN served HTML (DR-0258) named as a FILE, because Capacitor's local server routes an extension-less path to the root index.html, never to a folder's. Keys must equal the store's (app-store.js) and the TWA matrix's — a test holds all three together.
